vehicle.vt5.description: VT-5 export light MBT, 33.22 t. 105 mm rifled gun, modular armour swappable between ERA, ceramic composite and slat packages, with thick armour modules either side of the turret front.
vehicle.vt4.description: VT-4 export main battle tank, 52 t. 125 mm smoothbore gun with a 22-round carousel autoloader (not modelled in this version), plus a 12.7 mm remote weapon station.
vehicle.k2.description: K2 Black Panther main battle tank, 55 t. Armed with a 120 mm L/55 smoothbore gun, a bustle autoloader and a 12.7 mm remote weapon station.
vehicle.type10.description: Type 10 main battle tank, 44 t. 120 mm smoothbore gun, 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun and a 12.7 mm M2HB remote weapon station, on a five-road-wheel hydropneumatic suspension.
vehicle.tianma20.description: Chonma-20 (2026) main battle tank, about 48 t. 125 mm smoothbore gun, 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun and a 35 mm automatic grenade launcher remote weapon station, with turret-rear active protection and seven road wheels.
vehicle.ztz100.description: The ZTZ-100 is a fourth-generation Chinese main battle tank, modelled in its level-2 (add-on armour) configuration at 40 tonnes combat weight (board figure: 35 t; 25 t without add-on armour). It is 9.4 m long overall, 7.44 m hull, 3.7 m wide with skirts and 2.5 m high, with three crew in an armoured capsule in the hull front. Its 105 mm gun (52-55 calibres) is fed by a universal autoloader; muzzle velocity 1706 m/s, 720 mm RHA at 2000 m, 44 rounds. Traverse +-60 deg, elevation -8/+20 deg. Secondary arms are a 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun, a 12.7 mm remote weapon station and the GL-6 active protection system (two slewing launchers and four phased-array radars).
vehicle.leopard2a4.description: Leopard 2A4 main battle tank, 55.2 t. Armed with a 120 mm L/44 smoothbore gun (manually loaded by the loader), a 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun, a commander's 7.62 mm machine gun, and 16 smoke dischargers.
